policy: Read-only evidence audit. No candidate is automatically a baseline spawn.
Capture/map/epoch/agent/visibility segment isolates numeric-ID reuse; invisibility is not death.
Names resolve by encoded text; model IDs never supply names across epochs.
Name matches identify review groups, not proof of one spawn. Positions remain per segment.
Quest snapshots are context, not proof of causal gating; existing overlays stay separate.
No whole-map completeness claim: missing visibility and moving actors require further capture.

description.decoded:
A group of bandits has been terrorizing Lakeside recently. They have grown so bold that they ambushed a royal tax collector and stole a chest full of gold. That gold is vital to our war effort against the Charr and must be recovered! You look like you could give those bandits a good thrashing. Will you recover the stolen chest and then return it to Devona in Ashford for me? Reward:250 ExperienceFlame Artifact
Energy +3Tall Shield
Armor: 4

objectives.decoded: {sc}Recover the Ashford strongbox from the bandits.{s}Return the strongbox to Devona in Ashford.

description.decoded:
You're the Elementalist Sir Tydus was telling me about, aren't you? Well, I imagine he's right that you've got potential, but potential won't save you from a Charr firestorm. Experience will.

I suggest you head southwest to Ashford and talk to Devona. She's bound to have a task or two for you. Reward:250 Experience

objectives.decoded: {s}Follow the road southwest from town to Ashford. Talk to Devona.

description.decoded:
With all the dangers out in Lakeside, I can't believe the number of people who go running around by themselves. Why, I've already got my hands full resurrecting fallen soldiers without some novice Elementalist adding to the burden! Don't people know there are plenty of folks in Ascalon City who'd be perfectly happy to join them in their adventures?

I'll tell you what, if you promise to do your adventuring with an ally, I'll gladly give you a Signet that can resurrect fallen party members. Reward:100 ExperienceResurrection Signet

objectives.decoded: {s}Return to Ascalon City. Form a party with another player.

description.decoded:
I have a very important mission for you, Logger. The prince's love, Althea, will celebrate her birthday tomorrow. The prince has charged me with finding the perfect gift, one that is as unique and beautiful as Althea herself. What do you say? Can you help me? Reward:250 ExperienceInscribed Chakram
Energy +3

objectives.decoded: {s}Find the perfect gift for Lady Althea. It must be something beautiful.{s}Give the Beautiful Pendant to Captain Osric.

description.decoded:
Alas, I am behind on my rent, and my landlord, Gelsan, has run out of patience with me. I fear I will be put out of my home. I'll understand if you'd rather not help a Krytan; our nations were at war a long time. But I'm not your enemy, and I could really use some assistance.

My friend, Miller Upton, lives to the southwest. I know he'll help me if I can get a message to him. If you're going that way, could you tell him of my plight? Reward:500 ExperienceDivine Symbol
Energy +3

objectives.decoded: {s}Follow the road southwest from town to Ashford. Find Miller Upton and ask him to help Namar.

description.decoded:
I've got a job for you, if you're willing to work. A group of former students of mine are hiding out in the <c=@Quest>catacombs</c>. They fear my wrath, and rightly so. They have failed in their training and they must pay the price. They're very fond of Dark Pact, so you should be able to counter them using <c=@Quest>Blood Magic</c> to drain their Health.

Reward:<brx>250 Experience<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Enter the catacombs and destroy the Blood Fanatics.{s}Destroy 3 more Blood Fanatics.

description.decoded:
I need you to escort <c=@Quest>Farrah Cappo</c> on a mission to capture the outlaw Alain. Use the Protection Prayers I've taught you to keep Farrah alive, and she'll do the heavy lifting. I'm counting on you.

Reward:<brx>250 Experience<brx>

objectives.decoded: {sc}Meet Farrah Cappo in Lakeside County.{s}Keep Farrah alive while she hunts down the infamous Alain.

description.decoded:
Excuse me, you're Quest Logger, aren't you? I think <c=@Quest>Sir Tydus</c> was looking for you. He said he had some good news for you.

Reward:<brx>100 Experience<brx>10 Gold<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Go to the town square in Ascalon City. Talk to Sir Tydus.

description.decoded:
A horde of <c=@Quest>skale</c> down by the <c=@Quest>river road</c> has been hunting human prey to feed to their queen. You must put an end to this. If you can get them to flee into the woods, they should lead you right to her. Eliminate the <c=@Quest>skale queen</c> and report back to me.

Reward:<brx>500 Experience<brx>Power Shot<brx>Troll Unguent<brx>

objectives.decoded: {sc}Find the river skale queen and slay her.{s}Return to Artemis the Ranger for your reward.

description.decoded:
Ach! These worms will be the death of me! They've driven me off of my farm! Doesn't matter how many I kill. As long as there's a queen worm, more will be back the next day.

Here's what I'm thinking: Worms love devourer eggs, right? Can you get a devourer egg from Fadden Hathorn for me? I'll use it to lure the queen into the open, then you can squash her like the bug she is! Reward:250 ExperienceFire Wand
Fire Dmg: 3-5

objectives.decoded: {sc}Acquire a devourer egg from Fadden Hathorn in the devourer cave.{s}Take the devourer egg to Pitney in Ashford.

description.decoded:
I've heard talk among the townsfolk of unsettling rumors coming from Meerak the Scribe. Instead of babbling to random strangers, he ought to send word to the authorities if he's come across something truly important, but I'm sure he's too engrossed in his books to think of anything practical like that.

My duties in town keep me from looking into this matter myself, but if you could go to Ashford Abbey to the north and ask him about it, I'd appreciate it. Reward:250 ExperienceTall Shield
Armor: 4

objectives.decoded: {s}Speak with Meerak the Scribe in Ashford Abbey.

I've been looking for you everywhere, Logger. The king has ordered a new offensive against the Charr. This is your chance for glory and adventure, but you'll need to know more about your craft before going north of the Wall.

Tell you what: Travel to the southwest gate, which will take you to Lakeside County. I'll have Howland the Elementalist waiting for you outside. He can show you a trick or two. Reward:250 Experience

objectives.decoded: {s}Go out the gate to Lakeside County and talk to Howland the Elementalist.

description.decoded:
One of the great joys in a Ranger's life is earning the trust of an animal companion. If you are interested, I will give you a skill that will allow you to charm an animal. However, it would not be fitting, so close to a shrine of Melandru, to charm just any creature.

Along the path here you will find the shrine. Nearby you may find one of the rare cats known by the name Melandru's Stalker. If you can charm one of these animals, you will truly have Melandru's blessing. Reward:250 Experience

objectives.decoded: {sc}Find the shrine of Melandru's statue along the path in the woods.{sc}Use your Charm Animal skill on one of Melandru's Stalkers when it appears.{s}Return to Master Ranger Nente for your reward.
